items.name: IOSCO AI Guidance
items.description: IOSCO AI-related guidance and consultation reports for securities markets, referenced by section only: our own-language paraphrase; no IOSCO text is embedded

requirements.text: AI used for market surveillance - detecting market abuse, insider trading and manipulation - is governed so its outputs are reliable evidence for decisions affecting market participants.
requirements.rationale: Surveillance AI shapes enforcement; its error profile must be known, not assumed.

controls.description: Validate surveillance AI detection quality and document how alerts feed human analyst review.

requirements.text: AI-driven investment research is subject to due diligence and analyst oversight, so research outputs remain attributable and conflict-managed.
requirements.rationale: Automation does not transfer responsibility for research integrity away from the analyst.

controls.description: Apply due diligence to AI research tools and require named-analyst review before publication.

requirements.text: AI systems used for robo-advisory and automated wealth management support suitability assessment and meet disclosure requirements to clients.
requirements.rationale: Suitability obligations apply to automated advice as they do to human advice.

controls.description: Disclose the role of AI in advice and evidence suitability logic in client onboarding records.
